findings.issue: Home route passes the typeEnglishByName() Map into pokemonCard, which reads it with typeLabels[t.name] as a plain object; the label lookup always misses and silently falls back to humanize(), correct only because the 18 type English names equal their humanized names.
findings.suggestion: Pick one shape for typeLabels (e.g. always a plain object, or always a Map with .get()) and convert at a single boundary; add a comment or test asserting English labels are actually used.

findings.issue: Rapid search/select changes issue overlapping htmx requests with no ordering guard; a slow earlier response can swap stale results over a newer one.
findings.suggestion: Add hx-sync="this:abort" (or abort on htmx:configRequest via htmx.config handling) so a new filter request cancels the in-flight one.

findings.issue: The 'search from:#q' trigger fires an immediate request on clear, then the 'input changed delay:250ms from:#q' trigger fires a duplicate request for the same state 250ms later.
findings.suggestion: Drop 'search from:#q' and rely on the debounced input (the input event fires on the clear button too), or debounce both.

findings.issue: fetch() has no timeout, so a hung API request's promise stays in the cache forever (the cache only clears on rejection, which never comes).
findings.suggestion: Wrap fetch in AbortSignal.timeout(...) or a manual AbortController, so failures reject and the cache entry is dropped.

findings.issue: For htmx requests, renderNotFound returns a full layout document (which would be swapped into a fragment target), and onError returns plain text; with htmx 2's default responseHandling not swapping 4xx/5xx, an API failure during a filter change silently does nothing.
findings.suggestion: Return fragment-shaped 404s for HX-Request (and a styled error fragment), and consider configuring htmx responseHandling to swap a friendly error for 5xx on the filter target.

findings.issue: Static assets are served by registering serveStatic once per hard-coded path in a loop, duplicating the middleware registration.
findings.suggestion: Serve the public root once (e.g. app.use('/(styles.css|tokens.css|app.js|vendor/*)', serveStatic({ root: './public' }))) or mount public/ under a single prefix.

findings.issue: pokemonMovesData is ~50 lines of view-model/data assembly living in the routing module, unlike every other data builder which sits in api.js.
findings.suggestion: Move it into src/api.js (or a small view-model module) so app.js stays routing + orchestration only.

findings.issue: typePage normalises labels with Object.fromEntries(labels) ad hoc, papering over the Map/object inconsistency rather than fixing the shape once.
findings.suggestion: Normalise typeLabels at the data layer (export both a Map and a plain object with one canonical name) and use one accessor style everywhere.

findings.issue: speciesList is imported but never used in app.js.

summary: A clean, current-idiom Hono 4 + htmx 2 app with genuinely good layering, escaping and 404 handling, and graceful no-JS fallbacks. The notable defects are a latent Map/object typeLabels bug at the home-page cards and a set of htmx request-lifecycle gaps (no ordering guard, duplicate clear request, silent 4xx/5xx swaps, un-timed fetch). I'd merge after one small round of fixes.
